stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Alerts must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Alerts must not be in position 1.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Alerts and Billing must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Alerts and Billing must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Alerts → Dashboard → Chat → Billing → Export

distractorRationale.c: Even with the additional condition, Alerts → Dashboard → Chat → Billing → Export is permitted and makes this statement false.
